info.name: Anchorage Digital API Reference Addresses API
List all addresses for an asset

params.name: vaultId
params.description: The ID of the vault containing the asset type

params.name: assetType
params.description: The asset type to display addresses for

params.name: afterId
params.description: When paginating this is used to provide the starting point for the page to fetch (retrieved from the previous response body)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per query

items.docs:
Permissions required: **Read vault activity** or **Create address**



Get all addresses for the asset type within the specified `vaultId`.

info.name: Provision a deposit address for a wallet

params.name: walletId
params.description: An ID uniquely identifying an Anchorage Digital wallet

items.docs:
Permissions required: **Create address**




This endpoint allows you to request an asynchronous provision of a signed deposit address for a given wallet. For UTXO-based wallets a new address will always be provisioned upon request. For account-based wallets only one address may be provisioned per wallet and subsequent attempts will return the previously provisioned address.


Newly requested addresses may not be available for several minutes once requested.
